post.text:
Peptide products are being promoted on social media. They are unapproved medicines and pose serious health risks — with little evidence they work and no guarantee of what's in them.

See below for more information (link in the comments below).

source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
